text: dsh-loop-recover（DSH 网页客户端插件）：检测模型在思考或输出中陷入重复，并在同一任务中恢复执行。它接入 DSH 的 llm/stream 流程，针对 agent 请求监测文本和推理内容；命中后剪除重复后缀并结束当前流，可选用检查点压缩旧上下文，再通过 followup 续跑。还可识别工具查询换措辞重复、提示连续空转，并允许观察、只剪除或完整救援模式。适合希望自动处理中途死循环的 DSH 用户；不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-loop-recover detects repeated agent output or reasoning in DSH, prunes the loop, and ends the stream. Rescue mode can compact context and follow up the same task. It also catches repetitive tool searches. No extra API key is needed.
DSH 模型一直重复思考同一段内容，有办法自动打断并接着做吗？
想让 DSH 检测输出里的循环，把重复部分删掉后继续当前任务。
模型卡在反复生成相同文本时，怎样避免整轮任务直接失败？
能不能识别模型换着说法重复搜索同一个主题，并提醒它继续？
让 DSH 在检测到死循环后压缩上下文，再自动续跑。
How can I stop a DSH model from repeating itself and continue the same task?
I need DSH to prune looping output and automatically resume the agent.
Can DSH detect repeated tool searches with rephrased queries?
流内循环检测与剪枝：插件监测 agent 请求的文本和推理流，发现重复后缀时截去循环内容并停止当前流。
自动续跑：救援模式在当前回合结束后向原 agent 发送纠正提示并 followup；连续救援超过配置上限时暂停续跑。
检查点压缩：救援时可将旧会话上下文替换为包含原任务和循环提示的检查点消息，再续跑。
工具查询重复识别：跟踪工具调用的关键词新颖度，发现连续的低新信息查询后向 agent 发送停止重复检索的提示。

dsh-loop-recover README · Introduction：

dsh-loop-recover

Detects model dead loops and auto-rescues — the task resumes in place.

dsh-loop-recover README · Introduction：


English · 中文

dsh-loop-recover README · What It Does：Small local models (Ornith, some Qwen variants, etc.) can collapse into literal token loops (`ssssss...`) or semantic analysis loops — re-reasoning the same paragraphs forever. Plain loop guards just cut and stop; the task dies.

`dsh-loop-recover` breaks the full rescue chain:

dsh-loop-recover README · What It Does：- **Detect** — 5-layer detector: periodic, n-gram, anchor, char-run, sentence-pool + intent-level tool-query tracking
- **Prune** — cuts the repeated suffix mid-stream, leaves a one-line marker so the model knows something was removed
- **Compact** — replaces the poisoned context with a checkpoint summary (v4 `compaction/*` transaction) so the model can't replay the same reasoning
- **Resume** — auto-followups the same task with fresh sampling params — **no new session, no restart**
dsh-loop-recover README · What It Does：All inside one agent loop — the model keeps working after rescue.
dsh-loop-recover README · GUI (recommended)：Open **Plugins → Add plugin**, search `dsh-loop-recover`, click **Install**.

dsh-loop-recover README · CLI：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-loop-recover
dsh-loop-recover README · Configuration：Everything is editable on the plugin page — no YAML needed. 32 fields grouped: Basics / Rescue / Resume / Intent / Detection / Detector (Advanced).

dsh-loop-recover README · Configuration：| Group | Key fields |
|---|---|
| Basics | `mode` (rescue/cut/observe), `watch`, `language`, `keepLanguage`, `marker`, `debugLog` |
| Rescue | `maxConsecutiveRescues`, `compactOnRescue`, `stallCalls` |
| Resume | `retryTemperature`, `retryReasoningEffort`, `retryRequests` |
| Intent | `intentEnabled`, `intentNoveltyThreshold`, `intentConfirmCount` |

dsh-loop-recover README · Configuration：**Modes** — `rescue` (cut+prune+compact+resume, default), `cut` (prune only, no resume), `observe` (log only, zero intervention — use this to evaluate thresholds on your workload first).

dsh-loop-recover README · Why not other loop plugins：Different tools solve different problems — **don't stack them**:

| Plugin | What it does | Conflict |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh-agent-loop-guard` | Cuts at loop detection, stops turn | Both wrap `llm/stream` → double-cut, confused state |
| `dsh-client-auto-continue` | Resumes after interruption | Triggers extra resume → two conflicting continuation commands |
| `dsh-session-shift` | Context-pressure compaction → new session | Overlapping rescue → one compacts while the other shifts |
dsh-loop-recover README · Why not other loop plugins：Disable them when using this plugin.

dsh-loop-recover README · How it works：```
llm/stream (agent calls only)
  ↓ StreamLoopDetector — watches reasoning & text blocks
loop hit → cut repeated suffix → rewrite block-end → finish: stop
  ↓ commitLoopCompaction — v4 transaction, old context → checkpoint

Non-agent requests (title/summary generation) pass through untouched.

dsh-loop-recover README · Development：```sh
npm test        # 66 unit + integration tests
npm run check   # plugin load smoke
```

dsh-loop-recover README · Introduction：

dsh-loop-recover

检测模型死循环并自动救回，任务原地续跑。

dsh-loop-recover README · Introduction：


English · 中文

dsh-loop-recover README · 做什么：本地小模型（Ornith，部分版本 qwen 等）容易陷入两类死循环：**字面刷屏**（`ssssss...`）和**语义复读**（反复论证同一段话）。普通循环守卫只会"切断+终止"，任务直接死掉。

`dsh-loop-recover` 是完整的救援链：

- **检测** —— 五层检测器：周期扫描 / n-gram / 锚段 / 单字符刷屏 / 短句池 + 意图级工具查询跟踪
- **剪枝** —— 流内切掉重复后缀，留一行标记让模型知道这里删过东西
- **压缩** —— 被污染的上下文换成检查点摘要（v4 `compaction/*` 事务），模型没法再回放同样的推理
- **续跑** —— 自动 followup 原任务，换采样参数——**不开新会话，不重启**

全在同一个 agent 循环里完成，救援后模型继续干活。
dsh-loop-recover README · GUI（推荐）：打开 **插件 → 添加插件**，搜 `dsh-loop-recover`，点安装。

dsh-loop-recover README · 命令行：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-loop-recover

dsh-loop-recover README · 配置：32 个配置项全部在插件页可视化编辑——不用手写 YAML。分组：基本 / 救援 / 续跑参数 / 意图检测 / 检测阈值 / 检测器（高级折叠）。

| 分组 | 关键字段 |
|---|---|
| 基本 | `mode`（rescue/cut/observe）、`watch`、`language`、`keepLanguage`、`marker`、`debugLog` |
| 救援 | `maxConsecutiveRescues`（连续救援上限）、`compactOnRescue`（续跑前压缩）、`stallCalls`（空转提示） |
| 续跑 | `retryTemperature`、`retryReasoningEffort`、`retryRequests` |
| 意图 | `intentEnabled`、`intentNoveltyThreshold`、`intentConfirmCount` |

**模式**：`rescue`（剪+压+续，默认）、`cut`（只剪不续）、`observe`（只记日志零干预——先用它评估阈值再上救援）。

dsh-loop-recover README · 冲突说明：不同插件解决不同问题——**不要叠装**：

| 插件 | 做什么 | 冲突原因 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh-agent-loop-guard` | 检测循环即切断 | 同包装 `llm/stream` → 双重截断、状态错乱 |
| `dsh-client-auto-continue` | 中断后自动续跑 | 重复唤醒 → 两条冲突的续跑指令 |
| `dsh-session-shift` | 上下文压力压缩→新会话 | 职责重叠 → 一边压缩一边开新会话 |

用本插件时请禁用它们。

dsh-loop-recover README · 工作原理：```
llm/stream（仅 agent 调用）
  ↓ StreamLoopDetector 监控 reasoning & text 块
命中循环 → 剪除重复后缀 → 重写 block-end → finish: stop
  ↓ commitLoopCompaction——v4 事务，旧上下文换检查点

非 agent 请求（标题/摘要生成）原样透传不干预。

```
